Sure. However, we will only be able to confirm the rate for 4 months tomorrow, as we have requested the long-term rate from the management team and are currently awaiting their confirmation.

If you would like to secure the unit in the meantime, I can share the payment link for the security deposit and block the unit for you. Please note that the unit is listed on multiple booking platforms, so we are unable to guarantee its availability until the booking is confirmed.
